parameters.name: Databases
parameters.description:
An array that consists of the database objects.

>  You can specify up to 10 databases and 10 database accounts. The database accounts are not required. If you do not specify a database account, the user group is authorized to manage only the databases.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The bastion host ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.

>  For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost attach-database-accounts-to-user-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-zvp282aly06 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-id 2 --databases '[{"DatabaseId":"58","DatabaseAccountIds":["1"]}]' --region cn-hangzhou
